propositions: Reopening a closed child does not cascade to its still-closed parent, leaving an invalid state where a closed parent has an open child.
The reopen operation delegates to transition but lacks the parent-first cascade logic present in the open->in_progress edge.
The close-time guard blocks closing a parent with open children but does not prevent the symmetric case of reopening a child under a closed parent.

The existing _cascade_open_parent cascade seam is edge-specific; generalizing it to _cascade_parent_first with an edge table allows both the open->in_progress and closed->open transitions to share one implementation with consistent error handling and cycle detection.

A benign race where the parent status changes between the cascade decision and execution should not abort the child, matching claim_compute's behavior and bringing asymmetric failure semantics into parity.
